locations.name: Sundargarh
locations.summary: Odisha's northernmost major district, home to Rourkela Steel Plant and rich tribal heritage.

details.notable: Rourkela Steel Plant; significant Ho and Oraon tribal population; borders Jharkhand and Chhattisgarh.

locations.name: Jharsuguda
locations.summary: Smallest district by area, known as Odisha's energy capital with major thermal power stations.

details.notable: Ib thermal power station; major coal belt; Veer Surendra Sai Airport.

locations.name: Sambalpur
locations.summary: Cultural capital of western Odisha and home to the famous Hirakud Dam, the world's longest earthen dam.

details.notable: Hirakud Dam; Sambalpur University; famous Sambalpuri weave and Dalkhai folk dance.

locations.name: Bargarh
locations.summary: Gateway district for the Mahanadi as it enters Odisha; known for rice cultivation and Dhanu Yatra festival.

details.notable: Mahanadi enters Odisha at Padigan; Dhanu Yatra (world's largest open-air theatre festival); major rice bowl.

locations.name: Deogarh
locations.summary: Forested hill district through which the Brahmani river flows; rich in iron and manganese deposits.

details.notable: Iron and manganese deposits; dense forests; Brahmani river flows through.

locations.name: Keonjhar
locations.summary: Mineral-rich tribal district; Odisha's largest producer of iron ore and chromite.

details.notable: Major iron ore and chromite reserves; Baitarani river origin (Guptaganga Pahar); Gonasika — Baitarani source gorge.

locations.name: Mayurbhanj
locations.summary: Odisha's largest district by area; home to Similipal Tiger Reserve, one of India's most biodiverse forests.

details.notable: Similipal Biosphere Reserve and Tiger Reserve; Chhau dance origin; Odisha's largest district.

locations.name: Bolangir
locations.summary: Western plateau district known for the Tel river, textile weaving, and ancient temple town of Patnagarh.

details.notable: Tel river (largest right-bank tributary of Mahanadi); Patnagarh ancient temple; Sambalpuri textiles.

locations.name: Subarnapur
locations.summary: Also called Sonepur; confluence district of Mahanadi and Tel rivers, famous for Asia's largest cattle fair.

details.notable: Sonepur Cattle Fair (Kartika Purnima) — Asia's largest; Mahanadi–Tel confluence at Sonepur.

locations.name: Boudh
locations.summary: Compact forested district through which the Mahanadi passes before the Satakosia gorge.

details.notable: Gateway to Satakosia gorge; dense forests; Boudh Buddhist heritage.

locations.name: Angul
locations.summary: Central industrial district; home to Talcher coalfields, NALCO aluminium complex, and the Brahmani river.

details.notable: Talcher coalfields (Odisha's largest coal reserve); NALCO; Satakosia Tiger Reserve.

locations.name: Dhenkanal
locations.summary: Central district through which the Brahmani and Mahanadi river basins meet, with rich forest cover.

details.notable: Kapilash Shiva temple; Brahmani flows through; rich forest cover; Odisha's paddy granary.

locations.name: Cuttack
locations.summary: Odisha's commercial capital and 'Silver City'; ancient seat of the Odishan kings at the Mahanadi–Brahmani delta.

details.notable: Odisha's commercial capital; Cuttack Chandi temple; silver filigree craft; Barabati Fort.

locations.name: Jajpur
locations.summary: Ancient pilgrimage district on the Baitarani river; home to Biraja temple and Odisha's chromite belt.

details.notable: Biraja temple (Shakti Pitha); chromite and iron ore mining; Sukinda valley (world's largest chromite reserve).

locations.name: Kendrapara
locations.summary: Coastal Mahanadi delta district; home to Bhitarkanika mangroves and nesting ground for Olive Ridley sea turtles.

details.notable: Bhitarkanika National Park (mangroves and saltwater crocodiles); Gahirmatha — world's largest Olive Ridley nesting beach.

locations.name: Jagatsinghpur
locations.summary: Coastal delta district; home to Paradip Port — Odisha's only major seaport.

details.notable: Paradip Port (Odisha's only major seaport); Mahanadi delta fertile plains; fishing industry.

locations.name: Bhadrak
locations.summary: Northern coastal district at the Brahmani–Baitarani delta; Dhamra Port is a growing industrial hub.

details.notable: Dhamra Port; Brahmani and Baitarani merge at Dhamra; Akhandalamani temple.

locations.name: Baleswar
locations.summary: Northernmost coastal district bordering West Bengal; Chandipur is famous for missile testing.

details.notable: Chandipur Integrated Test Range (missile testing); Panchalingeswar temple; borders West Bengal.

locations.name: Nuapada
locations.summary: Westernmost district carved out of Bolangir; forested and drought-prone, bordering Chhattisgarh.

details.notable: Borders Chhattisgarh; Sunabeda Wildlife Sanctuary; largely forested plateau.

locations.name: Kandhamal
locations.summary: Hilly tribal district in the Eastern Ghats, homeland of the Kandha (Kondh) people and origin of several rivers.

details.notable: Kondh tribal homeland; Daringibadi — 'Kashmir of Odisha'; Rushikulya river source.

locations.name: Nayagarh
locations.summary: Central district through which the Mahanadi flows through the Satakosia gorge into the coastal plains.

details.notable: Satakosia Gorge (Mahanadi gorge through Eastern Ghats); gharial and mugger crocodile habitat.

locations.name: Khordha
locations.summary: Heart of Odisha; home to Bhubaneswar (state capital) and Lingaraj temple.

details.notable: Bhubaneswar — state capital and 'Temple City of India'; Lingaraj temple; Udayagiri and Khandagiri caves; AIIMS Bhubaneswar.

locations.name: Puri
locations.summary: Sacred coastal district; home to the Jagannath Temple, Puri beach, and the Chilika Lake.

details.notable: Jagannath Temple (one of Char Dham); Rath Yatra; Chilika Lake (Asia's largest brackish water lagoon); Konark Sun Temple nearby.

locations.name: Gajapati
locations.summary: Southern hilly district bordering Andhra Pradesh; origin of the Bahuda and Vamsadhara rivers.

details.notable: Mahendragiri peak (second highest in Odisha); Sorada and Paralakhemundi historic towns; borders Andhra Pradesh.

locations.name: Ganjam
locations.summary: Largest coastal district of southern Odisha; Rushikulya beach is a major Olive Ridley nesting site.

details.notable: Gopalpur-on-Sea; Rushikulya Olive Ridley mass nesting; Berhampur silk sarees; Tara Tarini temple.

locations.name: Kalahandi
locations.summary: Mineral-rich southern district known for bauxite deposits and origin of the Nagavali and Indravati rivers.

details.notable: Karlapat Wildlife Sanctuary; NALCO Damanjodi aluminium plant nearby; Indravati and Nagavali river origins.

locations.name: Rayagada
locations.summary: Tribal district in the Eastern Ghats known for the Kondh people, Niyamgiri hills, and bauxite controversy.

details.notable: Niyamgiri Hills (sacred to Dongria Kondh); major bauxite reserves; Rayagada railway junction.

locations.name: Nabarangpur
locations.summary: Remote southwestern district bordering Chhattisgarh; the Indravati flows through its plains.

details.notable: Indravati river; borders Chhattisgarh and Andhra Pradesh; largely tribal Gond population.

locations.name: Koraput
locations.summary: Mountainous tribal district; home to NALCO's aluminium refinery and the Kolab reservoir.

details.notable: NALCO aluminium refinery at Damanjodi; Kolab dam and reservoir; Deomali (highest peak in Odisha).

locations.name: Malkangiri
locations.summary: Odisha's southernmost and most remote district; the Machkund and Sabari rivers define its borders.

details.notable: Balimela reservoir; borders Andhra Pradesh and Chhattisgarh; Odisha's most remote district.
